title: Payment failures caused by exhausted MySQL connection pool
root_cause: The payment-service database connection pool was exhausted during a traffic spike.
resolution: Increased connection pool capacity, reduced connection hold time, and added pool saturation alerts.

title: Order API could not reach PostgreSQL primary
root_cause: A network policy change blocked order-service connections to the PostgreSQL primary.
resolution: Rolled back the network policy and verified database connectivity from order-service.

title: Payment API returned 500 while mysql-primary was saturated
root_cause: mysql-primary reached its connection limit and rejected payment-service connections.
resolution: Reduced connection pressure, increased database connection capacity, and added saturation alerts.

title: Billing writes failed after Postgres failover
root_cause: Clients kept using the old PostgreSQL primary endpoint after failover.
resolution: Refreshed DNS cache, restarted billing-service pods, and validated writes to the new primary.

title: Slow reporting queries exceeded client deadlines
root_cause: A missing index caused report aggregation queries to scan a large table.
resolution: Added the missing index and capped expensive report windows.

title: Checkout upstream requests exceeded deadline
root_cause: A downstream pricing dependency experienced elevated latency.
resolution: Scaled the dependency and adjusted retry and timeout settings.

title: Payment provider deadline exceeded during authorization
root_cause: The external payment provider degraded and exceeded the client timeout budget.
resolution: Enabled circuit breaker fallback and reduced retry amplification.

title: Inventory reservation timed out after queue lag
root_cause: Inventory workers lagged behind due to an oversized message batch.
resolution: Scaled consumers and reduced batch size.

title: API Gateway upstream timeout to checkout
root_cause: Checkout service latency exceeded the gateway timeout after a dependency slowdown.
resolution: Raised the circuit breaker threshold temporarily and fixed the downstream latency.

title: Login failures after token signing key rotation
root_cause: Auth-service instances used inconsistent token signing keys after rotation.
resolution: Synchronized signing keys and restarted stale auth-service instances.

title: Checkout rejected valid tokens after gateway config drift
root_cause: API gateway and checkout-service used different issuer configuration.
resolution: Restored issuer config and added token validation canaries.

title: OAuth callback failed after redirect URI change
root_cause: The OAuth provider still had the old callback URL.
resolution: Updated redirect URI and replayed login canaries.

title: Expired customer tokens caused mobile checkout failures
root_cause: A mobile client stopped refreshing access tokens after an SDK regression.
resolution: Rolled back the SDK and forced token refresh on app resume.

title: Cart failures caused by Redis connection outage
root_cause: The Redis primary was unavailable after an incomplete failover.
resolution: Completed Redis failover and restored client connectivity.

title: Cache stampede overloaded product database
root_cause: A hot product cache key expired simultaneously across all nodes.
resolution: Added TTL jitter and request coalescing for hot keys.

title: Session cache endpoint changed during deploy
root_cause: A deployment pointed session-service to a retired Redis endpoint.
resolution: Restored the endpoint and added config validation.

title: Worker restarts caused by heap exhaustion
root_cause: A batch job retained large payloads and exhausted the worker memory limit.
resolution: Reduced batch size, fixed payload retention, and increased memory monitoring.

title: Search indexer memory leak after parser release
root_cause: A parser release retained document buffers in memory.
resolution: Rolled back the parser and added heap profiling alerts.

title: Image worker exceeded memory during large uploads
root_cause: Workers decoded large images fully in memory instead of streaming.
resolution: Added streaming image processing and upload size limits.

title: API returned HTTP 500 after serialization regression
root_cause: A deployment introduced an incompatible response serialization change.
resolution: Rolled back the deployment and added response contract tests.

title: Null pointer exception in recommendation API
root_cause: A new recommendation model returned an unexpected empty feature set.
resolution: Added null guards and rolled back the model version.

title: Bad feature flag caused checkout 500 errors
root_cause: A feature flag enabled a code path that expected missing configuration.
resolution: Disabled the flag and added config validation at startup.

title: DNS failures prevented services from reaching payment provider
root_cause: CoreDNS pods were overloaded after a node rotation.
resolution: Scaled DNS resolvers and added DNS latency alerts.

title: Firewall blocked checkout to inventory dependency
root_cause: A firewall policy removed checkout-service from the allowed source list.
resolution: Restored the allow rule and added connectivity tests.

title: Config mismatch after release caused invalid credentials
root_cause: The release referenced a secret name that did not exist in production.
resolution: Rolled back the release and added secret existence checks.

title: Order service bad release caused response serialization errors
root_cause: A response schema changed without updating API clients.
resolution: Rolled back and introduced contract tests.

title: Email delivery delayed by message queue lag
root_cause: Notification consumers were underprovisioned during a campaign.
resolution: Scaled workers and capped campaign send rate.

title: Kafka rebalance loop stalled inventory updates
root_cause: Consumer processing exceeded max poll interval and triggered rebalances.
resolution: Reduced batch size and tuned max poll interval.

title: Search results stale after indexing worker failure
root_cause: Search indexing workers failed bulk writes after cluster pressure.
resolution: Replayed failed index jobs and scaled the search cluster.

title: Rate limit spike blocked legitimate checkout requests
root_cause: A WAF rule misclassified legitimate mobile checkout traffic.
resolution: Adjusted WAF rule and added customer segment monitoring.

title: Shipping provider degraded with intermittent 5xx
root_cause: The external shipping provider returned intermittent 5xx responses.
resolution: Enabled fallback carrier quotes and reduced retry pressure.

title: Fraud scoring API latency delayed payments
root_cause: The external fraud scoring API exceeded the payment timeout budget.
resolution: Enabled asynchronous fraud review for low-risk payments.

title: Secret rotation broke Redis authentication
root_cause: Redis password rotated but cart-service pods still used the old secret.
resolution: Restarted pods with the new secret and added secret rollout validation.

title: Database credentials mismatch after secret rollout
root_cause: Billing service used a stale database password after secret rotation.
resolution: Synchronized the database secret and restarted stale pods.
